narrative.intro: SLS Federal Services has $2.4B in contract obligations in FY2026 to date. SLS Federal Services won 3 awards this fiscal year, with an average award size of $793M. Current-year totals are partial (fiscal year to date). Obligations before FY26 are zero for FY21, FY22, FY23, FY24, and FY25, and all recorded obligations fall in FY26. The concentration of obligations into FY26 and the small award count imply a small number of very large awards rather than many small contracts. Contract values shown here are obligations; some largest-awards and expiring-contracts tables, where present, report total contract values instead of obligations. This profile matters for vendors and primes assessing teaming, cash flow, and near-term delivery commitments when considering SLS Federal Services as a partner or competitor.
